notes: The tall animated cover on the Now Playing screen is framed like the iPhone’s: you see nearly all of it, and it fades out just under the song title.
Animated covers now move on your Discord profile, not just the first frame.
Discord shows animated covers on its own now. The "Website for animated covers" box is gone.
Fixed the lyrics blinking for a moment when the first emoji reaction appeared.
Changing the lyric colour no longer makes the lyrics blink.

AutoMix, like Apple Music: your songs blend into each other in time with the beat. The next song is sped up or slowed down a little to match, comes in on its first beat, the bass swaps halfway, and its speed eases back to normal after (Settings → Playback).
Equalizer: 10 bands with presets like Bass Booster, Vocal Booster, Late Night and Rock (••• → Equalizer…, or Settings → Playback).
Crossfade no longer has a short gap when the next song starts.
Fixed the player column in 2.9.0: the cover slid off the left edge and the buttons sat on top of it.
Lyric clips: record a short video of the moving lyrics for stories and posts (••• → Clip). Sound is included for your own song files only.
Your stats: minutes listened, top songs and artists, streaks and when you listen most (••• → Your stats). Kept on this device only.
Lyrics quiz: a word disappears from the next line; type it before the line ends (••• → Lyrics quiz).
Search by lyrics: type a line in the library search to find the song.
Tap to sync: paste plain lyrics and tap as each line starts to make synced lyrics.
Translate lyrics that have no translation (••• → Translate lyrics; pick the language in Settings → Lyrics).
Send your own lyrics to AMLL TTML DB (••• → Send to AMLL TTML DB).
Karaoke (turns the vocal down), Even out volume, Crossfade and Smart shuffle in Settings → Playback, for your own songs.
Sleep timer (••• → Sleep timer): 15 to 60 minutes, or the end of the song, with a fade.
Lyric fonts and colours, including one taken from the album cover (Settings → Lyrics).
Your own emoji words for Emoji reactions (Settings → Fun).
New installer (app 2.9.0): global shortcuts (Ctrl+Alt+Space, arrows, L, P) and a phone remote that shows the lyrics on your phone over Wi-Fi.
Redesigned ••• menu: big buttons on top for Share, Mini player, Floating lyrics and Full screen, grouped items with icons, and What’s new and Credits at the bottom.
The menu shows where the current lyrics came from, and fits the window (it scrolls when the window is small).
Tap the lyric offset value to reset it.
Songwriters show for more songs: when the lyrics don’t list them, they’re looked up on MusicBrainz (Settings → Lyrics → Find songwriters online).
New Fun section in Settings with Emoji reactions: emoji float up when words like love, fire, money, stars or dance are sung.
Fixed updates not being used: the app sometimes thought a new version hadn’t started and went back to the old one.
The songwriters are shown after the last line, as in Apple Music, when the lyrics include them.
Under them, where the lyrics came from (Apple Music, AMLL TTML DB, NetEase, your own file…), with the TTML author for AMLL TTML DB lyrics.
New Credits page in the ••• menu.
Spicy Lyrics is no longer a lyrics source; lyrics come from Apple Music, AMLL, BiniLyrics, NetEase, QQ Music and LRCLIB as before.
Fixed: the moving background was missing since 2.4.0 (a Mac-only setting was switching itself on).

Lyric Player for Mac. On macOS 26 it uses Apple's real Liquid Glass: the mini player and floating lyrics are glass, and Settings → Background → Liquid Glass window turns the whole window into glass with your desktop showing through.
On a Mac it follows Spotify and Apple Music, with the Mac's own window buttons, menu bar icon and Dock.
Download page: files.ruytha.dev/download/lyricviewer.

Floating lyrics: the line being sung, floating over your other windows and games. Clicks go straight through it; hover it for its buttons: unlock to drag it somewhere else, change the text size, or close it (••• → Floating lyrics, or K).
Tray icon and Start with Windows (Settings → App): close the window and Lyric Player keeps following your music from the notification area.

Romanization for lyrics that don't have one: Korean and Japanese kana are romanized in the app, and lines with kanji or Chinese characters borrow NetEase or QQ Music's romanization (Settings → Lyrics → Romanize when missing).
Lyric offset per app: lyrics too early or late with Spotify or Apple Music? Fix it once with [ and ] and every song from that app starts with the same offset.
The ••• menu says where the lyrics came from; if they're the wrong version, pick others from there (or press /).
Lyric cards can use the moving Lyricify background.
What's new (this window) after each update, and Settings → About → Go back to the previous version if an update misbehaves.
Just the lyrics page: the full library window is gone; ☰ slides the library over the lyrics.
Updates now come straight from files.ruytha.dev, no reinstall.
Follows music playing on this PC (Spotify, Apple Music, browsers…) with its cover and synced lyrics.
The Apple Music (iOS) background, ported from Lyricify Backgrounds.
BiniLyrics as a lyrics source.
macOS-style window buttons.
